{{Quote|Our family was torn from greatness, crushed by the treachery of another&mdash;a man named Tulak Hord. [&hellip;] In restoring our bloodline to glory, you must not make the same mistake. Treachery is the Sith's endless game&mdash;you must win it.|Aloysius Kallig, to his descendant|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kallig family''' was a line of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] that originated with [[Aloysius Kallig]], a powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as the right hand of [[Tulak Hord]] before Hord turned on him and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. The Kallig line fell into disgrace for centuries until [[Darth Nox|one descendant]], a [[Slavery/Legends|former slave]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Zash]], encountered the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Aloysius Kallig in the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Eventually Zash would attempt to [[Duel in the Dark Temple|betray]] her apprentice in Kallig's tomb, resulting in her apparent death and her apprentice taking the title Lord Kallig. With Aloysius's aid, his heir eventually rose to become [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nox, a member of the [[Dark Council]]. The young [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Dark Lord]] had restored their family name to greatness, being acknowledged as the heir of Kallig and Tulak Hord by [[Khem Val]], Hord's greatest and most loyal servant.

Their family heirlooms were [[Kallig's Countenance]] and [[Kallig's lightsaber]].
